action.description: plan evaluates the safety checks and reports the restore window without changing anything. execute starts restoring the source instance into a new instance; call plan again with the same parameters to see its state and addresses. The source instance is never changed.

instance.description: Name of the Cloud SQL instance to restore, in the project of the function.

targetInstance.description: Name of the new instance to restore into. It must not exist yet.

restorePointInTime.description: RFC 3339 time to restore to, between the earliest and latest restore points reported by plan.
